title: Product Manager, Network & Accounts
description:
Product Manager; Network & Accounts 
 Location: Remote - United Kingdom United States, and Europe (France, Germany, Portugal) 
 About Worldly 
 Worldly is the world’s most comprehensive impact intelligence platform — delivering real data to businesses on impacts within their supply chain. Worldly is trusted by 40,000 global brands, retailers, and manufacturers to provide the single source of ESG intelligence they need to accelerate business and industry transformation.
 Through strategic and meaningful customer relationships, Worldly provides key insights around supplier performance, product impact, trends analysis, and compliance. When a company wants to change how business is done, we enable that systemic shift.
 Backed by a dedicated global team of individuals aligned by values, Worldly proudly operates as a public benefit corporation with backing from mission-aligned investors. Want to learn more? Read our story .
 About the Role 
 Worldly's Network connects the brands and retailers who source goods, the suppliers who make them, and the verifiers who confirm the accuracy of supplier assessments. Brands use it to find and connect with their suppliers, and suppliers join to share assessments with the brands they work with. Every Worldly product, including the Higg Index, depends on the Network being accurate, because an assessment is only useful when it's attached to the right facility and visible to the right brand. The Network is also the foundation of Worldly's transparency and traceability work: a brand can only trace what it sources if every supplier and facility in the chain appears in the Network once, correctly.
 This is a technical product role with a customer problem at the center of it. You will own the experiences that bring customers into the Network and keep them there:
 Getting in: finding a company or facility, joining or claiming it for their Worldly account, and resolving duplicates and conflicting claims so each real-world entity has one trusted record.
 Buying in: purchase, checkout and subscriptions.
 Managing: accounts, users and access once a customer is in.
 You will spend real time with brands, sourcing teams, suppliers, and our internal Customer Success teams to understand where these experiences help them achieve their goals and where they fall short, and you will set the measures that show whether they're improving.
 You'll collaborate with product managers across Platform and Traceability, turning what customers need into clear requirements for the shared services behind the Network.
 What You'll Do 
 Align teams and cross-functional partners so everyone understands what is being built (and why)
 Translate product vision into initiatives, epics and stories
 Run discovery with brands, suppliers, and Customer Success on how the Network is used; set and track KPIs
 Cultivate backlog prioritization for your areas of focus
 Write clear specs and plain-language definitions that engineers, CS, and customers can all use; support release planning and change management.
 We'd Like to See 
 5+ years of product management experience on technical or platform products
 You can reason about data as a graph: entities, identifiers, and relationships. You have shipped onboarding, identity or account experiences where users must find, claim or de-duplicate records, and you know what it takes for a customer to trust a record
 Comfortable reading data models and API contracts well enough to write precise requirements for platform teams and judge the trade-offs they propose
 Deep customer focus: you spend time with the people who build and use supplier networks, you can explain a technical concept to a sourcing manager in plain language, and you decide from what customers do, not only what they say
 Strong analytical skills; you define conversion, adoption and data quality metrics for the experiences you own and use them to prioritize
 It Helps If You Have 
 Experience with entity resolution, de-duplication or master data products
 Experience in apparel, footwear, or consumer goods supply chains: how brands source, who sits at each tier, and what brands and suppliers each need from a shared platform
 Exposure to sustainability data such as the Higg Index, or to supplier registries and third-party entity data.
 What We Can Offer You 
 Comprehensive benefits offerings. 90% employee premium and 75% spouse/dependent premium covered by Worldly.
 Company-sponsored 401k with up to 4% match.
 Incentive Stock Options
 100% Parental Paid Leave
 Unlimited PTO
 13 company holidays
 Life at Worldly 
 Our team is motivated to transform the way products are made. By helping our customers succeed in a new era of sustainable production, we are able to build technology that makes a difference on a planetary level.
 Our team represents over 15 countries, and brings unique experiences from technology to farming to the table. Surround yourself with kind, enthusiastic, and dedicated people who put collaboration and growth at the center of our shared goals.
 Benefits and Perks 
 Earn a competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. Get healthcare, retirement matching, and equity for US employees.
 Use the office stipend to get the supplies you need. Combat zoom fatigue with no-meeting Fridays.
 Flexible time off. Take the time you need to recharge. Our culture encourages team members to explore and rest to be their best selves.
 We're remote, not lonely. Join the culture committee, coffee chats, or a variety of other interest groups.
 Travel Notice 
 Roles at Worldly may require occasional travel to support business needs, including but not limited to team collaboration, customer engagement, or company events.
 Equity Statement 
 We believe it’s essential to reflect the diversity of those we strive to serve. True innovation happens when everyone has room at the table, including the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. We’re dedicated to building a culturally and experientially diverse team t

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Meet Yubico 
 Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.
 Why Join Our Mission? 
 At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of Speed with Integrity , pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values:
 Battle Friction: We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.
 Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.
 One Team: We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.
 Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the Yubico Developer Program , offering free open-source repositories , libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our Secure it Forward program.
 At Yubico, we offer: 
 Yubico Values: We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work here ).
 Social Connection: Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our Life at Yubico Page on LinkedIn and our awards here . 
 The Role 
 Yubico is looking for an experienced and highly collaborative Senior Product Manager to define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Tools, Libraries, and Applications (TLA) that underlie many of Yubico products and services. In this role, you will be a technical leader in our product management team and work closely with builders across a variety of our products from open source libraries and SDKs which empower other developers to create amazing things with our products, command line tools for managing and using YubiKeys and YubiHSMs, as well as graphical apps for mobile and desktop platforms.
 Our team works with authentication protocols like FIDO2/WebAuthn and uses cryptography to implement open standards. You'll have the opportunity to help us showcase our libraries in sample apps, making complex topics easier to use. You will help define and deliver the success of Yubico’s foundational product areas and expand the use of our technology to new and innovative areas that capture the market demand. You will serve as the strategic counterpart to our Senior Director of Engineering for Tools, Libraries & Apps.
 This role will own the "what" and "why" behind the enterprise-grade, secured, and reliable software used to build new applications and services that expand the value of Yubico hardware and services. To succeed, you will work closely with other product managers, engineers, solutions engineers, and operations teams to translate complex business and technical requirements into a robust definition for the foundational tools, libraries and applications in our expanding product portfolio
 Tasks & Responsibilities 
 Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership: Define and execute the long-term product vision and roadmap for our foundational tools, libraries, and applications, ensuring tight alignment with overarching business goals and customer needs.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner deeply across Engineering, Product, Operations, and Security teams to design high-impact capabilities that enhance product foundations that underlie efficiency and scalability of our solutions.
 Customer focus : Meet with customers to understand market demand and outcomes for new products
 Requirements Definition: Translate complex workflows and software requirements into clear, high-quality product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories.
 Technical Partnership & Conflict Resolution: Serve as the strategic unifier in cross-functional technical decisions. Actively synthesize competing priorities between product vision and architectural necessity, ensuring trade-offs are documented, data-backed, and optimized for long-term reliability.
 Data-driven Insights : Provide data-driven insights on the specific products being managed, including sales and financial performance, year-over-year trends, pipeline, etc.
 Full life cycle management: Manage the full life-cycle of a product from inception to end of life including: conception, market and requirements gathering, customer validation, creation of high-quality requirements document, management of engineering, marketing preparation, release and end-of-life processes
 Security & Compliance Management: Collaborate with security and engineering teams to ensure software systems seamlessly integrate with critical cryptographic infrastructure (such as PKI and HSMs) while maintaining Yubico's gold standard of security.
 Basic Qualifications 
 Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
 Experience: 10+ years of progressively broadening pro

title: Senior Product Manager, Mobile
description:
Why Mozilla? 
 Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser, and Pocket, a service for keeping up with the best content online. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 
 The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 
 About this team and role: 
 We’re looking for a hands-on Mobile Product Manager with a primary focus on Firefox for iOS, while also contributing across mobile (including Android).
 This role is about building a better browser, turning downloads into loyal users, and creating experiences that truly stand out. If you’ve shipped mobile apps, obsess over details that improve everyday use, and love turning user insights into real improvements, this is a great opportunity to drive impact at Firefox.
 What you’ll do: 
 Build a fundamentally better browser experience: fix bugs, refine UI and navigation, improve downloads, menus, performance, and all the small details that make Firefox noticeably better for users who care about privacy, quality and reliability.
 Drive strong activation and retention: focus on the new-user journey, quickly hooking people after they install the app, understanding where they drop off, and relentlessly optimizing the funnel through data, testing and iteration.
 Deliver differentiating features and experiences that make Firefox stickier for key user groups, the kinds of things others can’t or won’t build.
 Work closely with engineers, designers, data science and TPMs to ship high-impact improvements while balancing user needs, technical constraints, privacy and performance goals.
 Stay deeply connected to real users: track App Store trends and discussions, test apps hands-on, analyze reviews and analytics, and turn those insights into concrete enhancements for Firefox on iOS and Android.
 Monitor app health in App Store Connect and Google Play Console (crashes, ANRs, ratings) and support acquisition/retention efforts through ASO, store listings and growth experiments.
 Adapt and optimize Firefox for global markets (Europe, Japan, Asia etc.), keeping cultural differences and local realities like data constraints in mind.
 What you'll bring: 
 Proven Shipping Experience: Hands-on experience launching or managing apps on the iOS App Store and/or Google Play Store, with clear impact on user experience and metrics.
 Execution Focus: A strong track record of delivering features and improvements under deadlines through effective collaboration with engineering, design and cross-functional partners.
 Mobile & Browser Fluency: Deep understanding of iOS (and ideally Android) ecosystems, app store policies and web browser technologies, with genuine passion for what makes a great browsing experience.
 Data-Driven Iteration: Comfort using analytics, funnels, A/B testing and user feedback to improve activation, retention and overall product quality.
 User Obsession: Natural habit of studying apps, following trends on platforms like X/Twitter and Reddit, and testing experiences yourself to uncover opportunities.
 Global & Growth Mindset: Interest or experience growing products in international markets with sensitivity to local user needs.
 Bonus:
 Experience with mobile browsers or privacy-focused products.
 History of meaningfully scaling an app’s user base.
 Currently maintaining your own side project or app on the App Store or Google Play.
 What you’ll get: 
 Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
 Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
 Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
 Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
 One-time home office stipend
 Annual professional development budget
 Quarterly well-being stipend
 Considerable paid parental leave
 Employee referral bonus program
 Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)
 About Mozilla 
 Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.
 Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging 
 Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.
 We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. title: (Senior) Product Manager Smart Metering & Steering (m/f/d)
description:
1KOMMA5°
At 1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision:  Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.
 Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. 
Learn  more about our Product & Tech team! Deine Position
 As the energy transition accelerates, flexibilities in the low-voltage grid become increasingly important - and smart metering and steering of distributed energy resources sit at the heart of this shift. You take a central role in our end-to-end steering proposition, turning regulatory complexity into scalable, compliant, and customer-friendly products at the intersection of regulation, product, hardware, and field operations.
 Be the Expert on Smart Metering & Steering Regulation: Act as the first point of contact - internally and externally - for regulatory developments such as §14a EnWG, §9 EEG, §21 EnWG, and §118 Abs. 6 EnWG. Interpret legal frameworks, VDE FNN requirements, BNetzA rulings, and BDEW Guidelines, and help shape the rules of tomorrow through active industry engagement.
 Translate Regulation into Product Requirements: Define and prioritize development requirements for our engineering teams to ensure Heartbeat AI and connected hardware (e.g. §14a Steuerbox + Smart Meter) meets all compliance and performance standards.
 Drive Hardware Strategy and Rollout: Coordinate testing and lab capacities, prepare key hardware decisions, and operationalize the rollout of intelligent metering systems and Steuerboxen across our customer segment.
 Manage Service Providers and Market Partners: Own relationships with external service providers as well as DSOs and metering point operators, ensuring smooth collaboration and reliable market communication processes.
 Lead Cross-Functional Projects & Monitor Performance: Take overarching project responsibility for steering initiatives, define KPIs, monitor target achievement, and derive optimization measures from data and field feedback.
 Dein Profil
 General:
 3+ years of experience in the energy sector with a clear focus on metering and steering
 Strong project management skills, leading cross-functional initiatives across internal teams, network and metering point operators, and external service providers
 Analytical, structured thinker who can define KPIs and use data to drive decisions
 Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity and regulatory change
 Excellent written and spoken German and English - German is essential given the heavy regulatory and partner interaction
 Domain & Regulatory Expertise:
 Solid working knowledge of §14a EnWG and the grid-oriented control of consumption and generation assets, as well as the broader regulatory framework (MsbG, §9 EEG, §21 EnWG, §118 Abs. 6 EnWG)
 Familiarity with relevant technical standards and guidelines, as well as Marktkommunikationsprozesse and smart metering infrastructure
 Experience coordinating hardware testing, lab setups, or certification processes (e.g. for §14a Steuerboxen) is a strong plus
 Benefits
 You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
 With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
 You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
 You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe's most thriving scaleups
 You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
 Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
 Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
 Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

title: Staff Product Manager, Mobile
description:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team 
 From having their phone buzz as their first payment comes in to quickly resolving customer issues on-the-go, the Stripe mobile app is a critical lifeline for founders and business owners around the world. Our team is responsible for both the app platform and user-facing experiences. We collaborate closely with every product team to represent, shape, and enhance what it means to be mobile. The next chapter of our mobile efforts will take the quality bar to even greater heights and redefine mobile money movement. 
 We’re hiring a passionate product leader to shape the strategy, amplify its impact across the company, and accelerate Stripe’s mission to help internet businesses grow faster. 
 What you’ll do 
 As the product manager on the Mobile team, you will be accountable for making the mobile app indispensable for startup founders and business owners. How do we get every YC founder to use the app? How can we increase usage across different geographies? How can we get more product teams to contribute to the app? In other words, your role is to ensure founders and business owners are more successful when they use the mobile app. 
 Responsibilities 
 Deeply understand the needs of founders and business owners and identify the unique superpowers mobile can deliver for them
 Articulate the mobile strategy, prioritize the roadmap, and furiously execute to deliver user value
 Craft powerful product experiences with surprisingly great details 
 Steer the broader organization to understand and build for mobile use cases
 Collaborate with the go-to-market team to ensure the mobile app is discoverable and compelling
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 Minimum requirements 
 8+ years of product management or product-focused founder experience
 Persistence and a whatever-it-takes approach to ensure that your product is successful
 Strong understanding of user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) principles and best practices
 Technical familiarity with mobile development, cross-platform architectures, and machine learning
 Ability to collaborate with engineering and design across time zones (PST, EST, CET)
 Preferred qualifications 
 Founder background, or experience in a very early stage company environment
 Built award-winning mobile apps in the past
 Believe that fast software is the best software

title: Product Manager II (Soccer)
description:
We're hiring a Product Manager to own and scale Player ID, Teamworks ' soccer talent identification product. Player ID builds on technology proven with elite clubs and helps teams turn complex player data into better scouting, recruitment, and squad-building decisions. I'm Paul Gagnon, Manager, Product at Teamworks.
 This is a build-and-scale role with true ownership. You'll bring an established product into the broader Teamworks platform, shape it for a wider global market, and work across Data Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and go-to-market teams to turn sophisticated data into a product clubs can use and trust.
 The Role
 Own the end-to-end product development lifecycle for Player ID, from product strategy and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and iteration, with soccer as your core market
 Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Product, and Product Engineering to turn complex player data and models into clear, actionable product experiences for clubs
 Bring proven legacy capabilities into the Teamworks platform, shaping the product experience, roadmap, and packaging without starting from scratch
 Work with Sales, Customer Success, and Product Success to understand the market, balance client feedback with a strong product point of view, and scale Player ID across global soccer markets
 Engage directly with club analysts, scouts, and sporting directors to understand how they work and validate the product
 What I'm Looking For
 What You Must Bring
 5+ years of professional product management experience owning and shipping a product used by external customers, ideally one with meaningful technical or data complexity
 The technical fluency to engage credibly across the full product lifecycle, from raw data and models through APIs, workflows, and the front-end experience
 Experience owning a product end to end in a B2B SaaS environment, from strategy and discovery through delivery and adoption
 Strong product judgment and a history of taking ownership for outcomes, especially when information is incomplete and alignment must be built across teams
 Ability to influence without authority and align data, engineering, and commercial partners around a clear product direction
 Experience using product analytics (usage data, funnels, feature adoption, retention) to find insights and turn them into roadmap decisions, and to measure whether shipped work changed customer outcomes
 Even Better If
 You've taken a technical or data-rich product from one industry or customer segment and successfully adapted it to a new, specialized market
 You have professional experience with soccer and have built products to inform how how clubs use data to make scouting, talent identification, recruitment, or squad planning decisions
 You've worked in a startup or growth-stage environment where you influenced without authority, navigated ambiguity, and moved quickly with limited structure
 You have real world experience using AI tools to improve/empower your own product work (discovery, specs, analysis, prototyping)
 Why This Role
 Player ID is not a greenfield idea waiting to be validated. It builds on a product already used by elite clubs and on Teamworks' proven experience supporting player personnel decisions in other sports. You'll have the opportunity to own the product end to end, shape how complex soccer data becomes useful to clubs, and scale it into a broader global market where the competitive advantage of data is still being defined.
 This role is not eligible for sponsorship at this time. 
 Please submit your application through this posting only. We're unable to review applications or resumes sent via email, LinkedIn, or other channels. 
 To all recruitment agencies: Teamworks does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Teamworks employees or any other organization location. Teamworks is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. 
 About Teamworks
 We're the Operating System for Sports™, powering 7,000+ organizations worldwide, from collegiate programs to every major pro league. Founded in 2006, we've evolved from a messaging tool for college football into the leading sports tech platform, with 600+ global teammates building the future of sports tech. Our solutions span Personnel, Coaching, Performance, Operations, and Intelligence - helping teams recruit smarter, train better, stay compliant, and win.
 Teamworks is an equal opportunity employer - if you live our core values every day and are honest, hardworking, humble, committed, innovative, and an all-around exceptional person, you'll thrive at Teamworks. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and take affirmative action to not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, promotion, termination, compensation, benefits, and training. Teamworks is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email talent@teamworks.com .
